# display tree 

```{r}

# Load the tree and tip data
tree <- read.nexus("../OLD_trees/Dennytree_timed_with_nucLSU.tre") %>% ladderize(right=F)
new_tips <- read.csv("spreadsheets/tip_update.csv")
tree$tip.label <- as.character(new_tips[[2]][match(tree$tip.label, new_tips[[1]])])

# Color the subtrees (states: 1, 2, 3, 4)
compTree_colored <- tree
compTree_colored <- paintSubTree(compTree_colored, node=109, state="Outgroup", stem=F)
compTree_colored <- paintSubTree(compTree_colored, node=115, state="Decomposer", stem=T)
compTree_colored <- paintSubTree(compTree_colored, node=124, state="Inopinata", stem=T)
compTree_colored <- paintSubTree(compTree_colored, node=127, state="Ectomycorrhizal", stem=T)

# Extract tree data for plotting
p <- ggtree(compTree_colored, layout="circular")
tree_data <- p$data

# 🔄 Manually annotate state per node using node ancestry
tree_data <- tree_data %>%
  mutate(state = case_when(
    node >= 109 & node < 115 ~ "Outgroup",
    node >= 115 & node < 124 ~ "Decomposer",
    node >= 124 & node < 127 ~ "Inopinata",
    node >= 127              ~ "Ectomycorrhizal"))

# Define colors that match the corrected state values
cols <- c("Outgroup" = "black",
          "Decomposer" = "green",
          "Inopinata" = "purple",
          "Ectomycorrhizal" = "orange")  

# 🌿 Final nicely formatted tree with colored branches
p %+% tree_data + 
  geom_tree(aes(color=state), size=1) + 
  geom_tiplab(size=2.5, offset=0.02, aes(angle=angle)) +
  scale_color_manual(name="Niche Group", values=cols, na.translate=FALSE) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(face="bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size=10),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold", size=16),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Phylogenetic Tree of *Amanita*: Spore Shape vs. Niche") +
  theme_transparent()  # Clean background


```

ggsave("phylogenetic_tree_amanita.png", plot = last_plot(), width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "transparent")
